verdict.rationale: Docs confirm games can be compiled to iOS, Android, Steam and native apps, but explicitly only 'using 3rd party tools' (e.g., Cordova/Electron-style wrappers), not a first-party export pipeline; no console (Xbox/PlayStation/Switch) partner program or export path is mentioned anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: first-party or documented partner console export path, and any built-in desktop/mobile packaging tool rather than reliance on unspecified third-party tools.
